structuralFindings: Three distinct booking modes, each with its own rate table: (1) Boutique/individual-room booking on an All Inclusive basis, (2) Boutique/individual-room booking on a Half Board basis, (3) Exclusive Use of the entire property (flat per-pax rate scaling down as guest count rises, no seasons).
Both Boutique tables (AI and HB) share the same two room categories (Deluxe Room, Presidential Suite) and same High/Low season windows, each with Rack and Nett sub-rows.
Presidential Suite has no stated Child Rate column in either Boutique table — left blank/not offered in the source, recorded as null rather than assumed equal to Deluxe.

Exclusive Use pricing is a genuinely different shape: a sliding per-person rate that decreases as total guest count (2 through 8) increases, plus flat Extra Adult/Extra Child/Infant add-ons — a shared-cost-across-group model, not a per-category room rate.

Exclusive Use carries a Festive/Easter season supplement of $50pp/night layered on top of the flat per-pax figure — the flat rate table itself has 'No Seasons' per its own header, so this supplement is the only seasonal variation for that mode.
Child age bracket for Boutique bookings is 4-12 (not the more common 2-12 seen elsewhere); Exclusive Use uses a different bracket again — Extra Child 4-13, Infant defined as 3 y/o and under free.
